hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ -n "${RAILWAY_API_TOKEN:-}${RAILWAY_TOKEN:-}" ] && command -v railway >/dev/null 2>&1; then railway status >/dev/null 2>&1 || railway link -p c651eed9-55bb-464b-98f3-6d8369565740 -e production -s kiki-backend >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "[hook] railway link failed — deploys may not work"; fi; for d in backend analytics; do if [ -f "$d/package.json" ] && [ ! -d "$d/node_modules" ]; then (cd "$d" && npm ci --silent >/dev/null 2>&1) || echo "[hook] npm ci failed in $d"; fi; done; exit 0'
